message: No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching (URLs, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) is present in the code, so no integrity verification or source authentication is implemented.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data anywhere in the preparation pipeline.
No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle to save/load models and data but performs no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision validation on any loaded artifacts.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training; StratifiedKFold is used for splitting but not as a validation/alerting mechanism.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or supporting files.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in any of the training code files.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-testing routines are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train/test/validation splits are separated, there is no signing, hashing, or cryptographic isolation of evaluation data, and in one branch test is explicitly set equal to valid (line: 'test = valid'), undermining hold-out integrity; no independent metrics or tamper-detection mechanisms are

No detected input sanitization: The only input validation present is a type check on the data_formatter object; there are no shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input guards on the actual data fed to the models.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (train_scores, test_scores, val_scores) are collected and written directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular ML pipeline (CSLR/cost-sensitive classification), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
